notes.title: Deepening Fire coming soon April 20!
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

We're excited to announce that Deepening Fire will be fully released at 15:00, April 20(CST). The game is priced at $11.99, and launch discount percentage is 20% off the price during the first week.
This fully released version will present you with all the content of the game.

Cautions:
- Demo saves compatible with the full release version.
- If you have purchased and played the full release version, do not read the save in the trial version, otherwise, the game data may be wrong

The official release includes content improvements and a major update: Ruinous Fire.
In the official version, you will meet new strong enemies and boss battles, defeat them, and you will get special weapons and armor, as well as richer character appearances. Other content will be updated on an ongoing basis.

-1.0.0 update notes:

- New: Ruinous Fire
Includes new enemies, bosses (player-created characters in the demo event), new weapons and armor, more custom character styling, and new achievement challenges. Ruinous Fire Mode will increase the difficulty of the game in the first round and can be turned on selectively.

Optimization and modification:
- At the beginning of the game, more facial features and pupil color options are available
- Optimized weapon sound effects for enemy soldiers
- Optimized enemy soldiers' movements and death animations
- Optimized some combat effects
- Multiple Glacial Kindling can be purchased at once at the Hall
- The character does not read the text in the scene while fighting

- Fixed an issue where after being hit fell or stabbed, the protagonist would retreat after the end of invincibility
- Fixed a bug where the hint text could be displayed at the beginning
- Fixed the issue that when the item information is displayed, the treasure chest is opened again and the information cannot be displayed normally
- Fixed an issue where information was not displayed normally when killing bosses to obtain items
- Fixed the issue where the dialogue text suddenly disappeared after killing the Gatekeeper
- Fixed the issue that the font of some NPC conversations was not uniform

- Adjust the overall difficulty
- Adjust damage judgment for some enemies
- Adjust the balance of weapons, armor, and firebrand

If you like our game, please add it to your wishlist and join our communities for the latest news! Also welcome to join our discord: https://discord.com/invite/wwnagze3Jp

Cheers,
ETime Studio

notes.title: Do you support that the game gonna add difficulty grading selections?
notes.content:
Deepening Fire Early Access version is here now. Thank you very much to every player who pays attention to our game, at the same time we have also received a large number of feedback from different players, connoisseurs, UP, etc... We know that the existing version of the bounce and other judgment is too strict, boss attack power is too high and other problems that make the game too difficult. We are in full swing to adjust, have been adjusted twice, and at the same time solicited from everyone.  If the game is divided into high and low difficulty settings, do you support it?  

 Hoping you give us your own opinion here!  Thank you again for your suggestions

notes.title: Update notes for v0.9.1a today!
notes.content:
After the current feedback, we understand that the biggest demand of everyone at present is that the fault tolerance rate is too low and the block is too harsh. The following adjustments will be made and this version will be updated after a short test. The key issues that you have reported will also be adjusted in the next version.

v0.9.1a Update notes:

- Overall level difficulty reduced
- Significantly reduce the strength of the Moon Kindler
- Reduce bleeding from non-precision blocks
- Extended precision block determination time
- Temporarily eliminate damage when bats and mosquitoes are hit
- Greatly increased the drop of blue fire from the boss "Defender"

The Flashback Skill, Firebrand, is our initiative, somewhat adventurous system, and it's the core idea that was finalized from early testing. After becoming proficient, there will be a refreshing combat experience.
The current game is the first day of EA version, and the difficulty of the game may be not make sense. 
Thank you for your support and understanding.

notes.title: "DEEPENING FIRE" join the "Going Rogue: A Festival of Persistence" on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear survivors,
"DEEPENING FIRE" has been confirmed to join the "Going Rogue: A Festival of Persistence" on Steam! At that time, we will provide you with a new free demo of the game. We are looking forward to your participation. If you like the game, you can add it to your wishlist and get the latest news at any time! 
We apologize for any inconvenience caused that the demo provided will not have the English version but we will add it to EA, and we will add other languages version as well.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1642790/_DEEPENING_FIRE/

Event dates：
May 3 - May 10 at 1 AM Beijing Time(BJT)
May 2 – May 9  at 10 AM Pacific Time (PT) 

Since the game has been in its final development and polishing stage, if you have any better suggestions and feedback on "DEEPENING FIRE", please feel free to send them to DeepeningFire@gmail.com, we will read every piece of message carefully and give a reply!

Compared with the last demo of the next fest sale, the new content is:
1. The official version of the plot and NPC
2. Hidden maps and hidden bosses

In addition, this version is more aggressive in difficulty, I hope that you enjoy it.

The free trial version of the demo will be temporarily closed after the "Going Rogue: A Festival of Persistence". If there are any updates, please pay attention to our latest announcement!
